title: Dual Quaternion Skinning Comparison Viewer
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN, r160+) that implements a dual quaternion skinning comparison viewer with two animated GLTF models side by side.

## Scene Setup
- Dark background (0x1a1a2e). Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 1.5, 5) looking at (0, 1, 0).
- Add a HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x444444, 1.5) and a DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2) at (3, 5, 3) casting shadows.
- Add a ground plane (20x20, color 0x2a2a3e) at y=0 receiving shadows.
- Add OrbitControls with target (0, 1, 0), damping enabled.

## Model Loading
- Load 'CesiumMan.glb' using GLTFLoader. Place TWO instances of this model: one at x=-1.5 (left panel, labeled 'Linear Blend') and one at x=1.5 (right panel, labeled 'Dual Quaternion'). Scale both to 1.0. Both should play their default animation via AnimationMixer.
- Load 'InterpolationTest.glb' using GLTFLoader. Place it at position (0, 0, -2) scaled to 0.5. Play its default animation. This model serves as an interpolation reference.
- Each model clone should have its own AnimationMixer.

## Skinning Modes
- The LEFT CesiumMan represents standard Linear Blend Skinning (LBS). Keep its skeleton as-is.
- The RIGHT CesiumMan represents Dual Quaternion Skinning (DQS). To simulate the visual difference, apply a custom vertex displacement: iterate over the right model's SkinnedMesh and set mesh.skeleton.bones forEach bone => store original quaternion. On each frame when DQS mode is active, slightly normalize bone influences to reduce the 'candy wrapper' artifact (scale bone positions by 0.98 factor toward the skeleton root to simulate volume preservation).
- Track a `skinningMode` variable: 'comparison' (both visible), 'lbs_only' (left only), 'dqs_only' (right only).

## Animation Controls
- Maintain a `timeScale` (default 1.0) applied to all mixers.
- Maintain a `paused` boolean (default false).
- Maintain an `animationTime` tracking the elapsed animation time in seconds.
- Maintain a `currentFrame` computed as Math.floor(animationTime * 30) (at 30fps equivalent).

## User Interactions
- SPACE key: toggle pause/resume of all animations.
- LEFT/RIGHT arrow keys: when paused, step animation backward/forward by 1/30 second (single frame step).
- UP/DOWN arrow keys: increase/decrease timeScale by 0.25, clamped to [0.25, 3.0].
- Key '1': set skinningMode to 'lbs_only' (hide right CesiumMan and InterpolationTest).
- Key '2': set skinningMode to 'dqs_only' (hide left CesiumMan and InterpolationTest).
- Key '3': set skinningMode to 'comparison' (show all models).
- Key 'R': reset all animations to time 0, set timeScale to 1.0, unpause.
- Key 'B': toggle bone visualization helpers on/off for both CesiumMan instances using THREE.SkeletonHelper.

## HUD / DOM UI
- Create a top-left HUD panel (semi-transparent dark background, white text, monospace font, padding 12px, z-index 100) showing:
  - 'Mode: [comparison|lbs_only|dqs_only]'
  - 'Time Scale: [value]x'
  - 'Animation Time: [value]s'
  - 'Frame: [currentFrame]'
  - 'Paused: [yes/no]'
  - 'Bones Visible: [yes/no]'
  - 'Models Loaded: [count]/3'
- Create labels above each CesiumMan: 'Linear Blend Skinning' (left) and 'Dual Quaternion Skinning' (right) using CSS-positioned divs or THREE.js sprite text.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
  - `modelsLoaded`: number of successfully loaded models (target: 3 — left CesiumMan, right CesiumMan, InterpolationTest)
  - `skinningMode`: string ('comparison', 'lbs_only', 'dqs_only')
  - `timeScale`: number
  - `paused`: boolean
  - `animationTime`: number (seconds, 2 decimal places)
  - `currentFrame`: integer
  - `bonesVisible`: boolean
  - `leftModelVisible`: boolean
  - `rightModelVisible`: boolean
  - `interpolationModelVisible`: boolean
  - `mixerCount`: number of active AnimationMixers
  - `leftModelPosition`: {x, y, z}
  - `rightModelPosition`: {x, y, z}
  - `interpolationModelPosition`: {x, y, z}
  - `skeletonHelperCount`: number of SkeletonHelper objects in scene
  - `animationClipCount`: total number of animation clips loaded across all models
  - `leftBoneCount`: number of bones in left CesiumMan skeleton
  - `rightBoneCount`: number of bones in right CesiumMan skeleton
physics_constraints: Animation time must be non-negative and NaN-free. TimeScale must remain clamped to [0.25, 3.0]. Frame stepping must advance/retreat by exactly 1/30 second. Volume preservation factor for DQS simulation must stay at 0.98. All model positions must remain stable at their assigned coordinates.
